name: Tactician (Black Flame Studios’ Lab)
body:
Tacticians exploit the weaknesses of enemies, and help their allies in taking down particularly dangerous threats. The Tactician may be deemed as a support-type, however they can also hold their own in battle and are certainly not slouches when it comes to fending for themselves.

Alignment: Any.

Hit Die: d10

Starting Wealth: 5d6 x 10 gp (average 175 gp).

Class Skills

The tactician’s class skills are Acrobatics (Dex), Appraise (Int), Bluff (Cha), Craft (Int), Diplomacy (Cha), Disable Device (Dex), Intimidate (Cha), Heal (Wis), Knowledge (All) (Int), Linguistics (Int), Perception (Wis), Perform (Cha), Profession (Wis), Ride (Dex), Sense Motive (Wis), Sleight of Hand (Dex), and Stealth (Dex)

Skill Ranks per Level: 4 + Int modifier.

Table: Tactician
Level	Base Attack Bonus	Fort Save	Ref Save	Will Save	Special
1st	+1	+0	+2	+2	Cerebral edge, tactical training, thoughtful step, stratagem
2nd	+2	+0	+3	+3	Coordination +1/+1
3rd	+3	+1	+3	+3	Battle focus, stratagem
4th	+4	+1	+4	+4	Specialized tactics
5th	+5	+1	+4	+4	Rally, stratagem
6th	+6/+1	+2	+5	+5	Coordination +2/+2
7th	+7/+2	+2	+5	+5	Tactical style, stratagem
8th	+8/+3	+2	+6	+6	Deadly knowledge
9th	+9/+4	+3	+6	+6	Opportune strike, stratagem
10th	+10/+5	+3	+7	+7	Coordination +3/+3, evasion
11th	+11/+6/+1	+3	+7	+7	Inspiring speech, superior intellect, stratagem
12th	+12/+7/+2	+4	+8	+8	Enhanced tactical style
13th	+13/+8/+3	+4	+8	+8	Void’s intellect, stratagem
14th	+14/+9/+4	+4	+9	+9	Coordination +4/+4
15th	+15/+10/+5	+5	+9	+9	Enhanced deadly knowledge, stratagem
16th	+16/+11/+6/+1	+5	+10	+10	Masterful speech
17th	+17/+12/+7/+2	+5	+10	+10	Master tactical style, stratagem
18th	+18/+13/+8/+3	+6	+11	+11	Coordination +5/+5
19th	+19/+14/+9/+4	+6	+11	+11	Stratagem
20th	+20/+15/+10/+5	+6	+12	+12	Heroic inspiration
Class Features

All of the following are class features of the tactician.

Weapon and Armor Proficiency

Tacticians are proficient with all simple and martial weapons, with all types of armor (heavy, medium, and light), and with shields (except tower shields).

Cerebral Edge (Ex)

At 1st level, tacticians learn to use their intellect and understanding of enemies’ weak points. Tacticians use their Intelligence modifier on weapon attack rolls in place of Strength or Dexterity modifier.

At 3rd level the tactician uses their Intelligence modifier on damage rolls in place of Strength or Dexterity modifier. This damage is treated as precision-based damage for the purpose of creatures immune to precision damage, however it is multiplied on critical hits and functions normally otherwise.

Tactical Training (Ex)

At 1st level, a tactician receives a teamwork feat as a bonus feat. They must meet the prerequisites for this feat. As a standard action, the tactician can grant this feat to all allies within 30 feet who can see and hear them. Allies retain the use of this bonus feat for 3 rounds plus 1 round for every two levels the tactician possesses. Allies do not need to meet the prerequisites of these bonus feats. The tactician can use this ability once per day at 1st level, plus one additional time per day at 5th level and for every 5 levels thereafter.

Tactician levels stack with levels from other classes (such as cavalier) which grant the Tactician special ability.

Thoughtful Step (Ex)

A tactician adds their Intelligence modifier as a bonus on all Reflex saves. If the Tactician also has the Divine Grace class feature, they must choose to add either their Intelligence or Charisma modifier to Reflex saves; these bonuses do not stack.

Stratagem

Tacticians learn new techniques and ways of aiding allies in times of need, as well as strategies they can use against the enemy. At 1st level and every odd levels thereafter, the tactician gains a new Stratagem. Unless specifically noted, the tactician cannot select a stratagem more than once.

A complete listing of stratagems can be found here: Stratagems

The save DC for Stratagems are 10 + half tactician level + their Intelligence modifier.

Coordination (Ex)

At 2nd level, a tactician can begin to coordinate their teammates’ movements. As a move action they can issue orders to the entire party, telling where and how to strike.

This grants a +1 insight bonus to attack rolls and a +1 insight bonus to AC to all allies within 30 feet who are able to see or hear the tactician. The bonuses provided increase by +1 every four levels thereafter. This bonus lasts for 3 rounds plus an additional round for every Tactician level he possesses.

Coordination also grants its bonus to the tactician themselves, alongside their allies.

Tacticians can use this ability once per day, plus an additional time per day every 3 levels thereafter (to a maximum of 7/day at 20th level).

Battle Focus (Ex)

At 3rd level, the tactician can steel their mind and enter a state of extreme focus.

Entering this state is a swift action, and upon doing so they must choose either Barricaded Mind or Focused Body. This lasts a number of rounds equal to the tactician’s Intelligence modifier, plus additional rounds if they choose to concentrate to main the state. At the end of each round after the duration’s end, the tactician makes a Concentration check at the end of their turn to maintain the focus on the ability. This DC is equal to 10 plus 2 for every 5 points below their maximum hit points that their current hit points are.

Barricaded Mind: Entering this state grants the tactician the edge to resist would-be mental invaders. They add an insight bonus to their Will saves equal to 1 plus their Intelligence modifier. They can choose to immediately end this benefit in order to reroll a failed Will save while it is active (this reroll still benefits from the insight bonus).

Focused Body: While in this state the tactician is able to make attack with deadly precision. If they are currently utilizing Coordination, they add 1d6 points of precision damage on the first attack roll they make on their turn. This precision damage increases by +1d6 for every odd level thereafter (to a maximum of 9d6 at 19th level).

Specialized Tactics (Ex)

At 4th level the tactician may grant a single ally within 30 feet the effects of a teamwork feat, however the tactician can use any teamwork feat they currently have for this ability. Using this expends a use of their tactical training ability.

Rally (Ex)

At 5th level as a move action the tactician can call for their party to rally around them. All of the tactician’s allies can choose to take an immediate action to move up to their base movement speed towards the tactician. Any movement made through this immediate action still provokes attacks of opportunity if moving through a threatened square. This ability can only be used once per encounter.

Tactical Style (Ex)

At 7th level, a tactician advances his tactical acumen and adapts quickly to situations. A tactician using his Coordination grants one of these abilities to his allies in addition to the normal bonus. This benefit is granted upon using Coordination, and can only be changed if Coordination is ended and restarted.

Effects which add the Coordination bonus to other effects are still insight bonuses, and thus do not stack with other sources of insight bonuses unless otherwise specified.

Offensive: Coordination now grants a +2d6 precision damage as bonus damage. This stacks with existing precision damage (such as sneak attack) and does not multiply on critical hits.

Critical: The Coordination bonus on attack rolls is doubled for confirming critical hits.

Penetrating: Coordination bonuses adds to checks to overcome spell resistance.

Defending: Add the Coordination bonus to all saving throws.

Evading: Add the Coordination bonus to combat maneuver defense.

Deadly Knowledge (Ex)

At 8th level the tactician has become adept at studying their enemies and exploiting their weaknesses. As part of an attack, the tactician can make a Knowledge check against the creature as if they were attempting to identify the creature.

The DC for the knowledge check is 10 + the creature’s hit dice. On a successful roll, the tactician can choose to inflict an elemental vulnerability or material-based vulnerability the creature doesn’t actually have. While afflicted, this creature is counted as having this vulnerability for 1 minute. Creatures who are affected by this ability are immune to further uses of it for the next 24 hours.

This energy type chosen cannot be a type the creature is immune or resistant to, and the material chosen cannot be a material they are immune to. If the creature possesses DR which is overcome by a material (such as DR/adamantine) and a material vulnerability is chosen that would be reduced by DR, it is not given as a vulnerability but instead added as a material which bypasses the DR of the creature.

Opportune Strike (Ex)

At 9th level, the tactician can make a single attack as a standard action. If the attack hits, the enemy must make a Fortitude save (DC = 10 + half tactician level + the tactician’s Intelligence modifier) in addition to taking normal damage. Upon a failed save, the enemy is afflicted with one of the following conditions of the tactician’s choice: Sickened, Shaken, or Fatigued. This status effect lasts for a number of rounds equal to 3 + half the tactician’s level.

Evasion (Ex)

At 10th level, a tactician can avoid even magical and unusual attacks with great agility. If they make a successful Reflex saving throw against an attack that normally deals half damage on a successful save, they instead take no damage.

Inspiring Speech (Ex)

At 11th level, before an encounter a tactician may spend at least 2 minutes giving their group a pep talk or rally speech about a known enemy. All allies hearing this speech gain a temporary +2 insight bonus to an ability score of their choosing. The tactician can use this ability a number of times per day equal to his Intelligence modifier (minimum of 1). The bonuses from the speech apply only during the ensuing fight and last until the fight ends.

Superior Intellect (Ex)

At 11th level a number of times per day equal to his tactician level, he may double the bonus his Intelligence modifier grants on a single skill check or intelligence check. For example, on a Knowledge (local) skill check where he normally has a +4 bonus from Intelligence, using this ability would treat the bonus as +8.

Enhanced Tactical Style (Ex)

At 12th level the tactician adds new benefits they can apply with their Coordination.

Speed: Coordination now grants a +10 insight bonus to land speed.

Range: Coordination increases the range of ranged weapons by 5 feet per point of Intelligence the tactician possesses.

Maneuver: While benefitting from Coordination, allies no longer provoke attacks of opportunities when performing combat maneuvers, even if they do not possess the requisite feats.

Health: Coordination grants allies temporary hit points as per Greater Heroism equal to the tactician’s level and fast healing 1.

Void’s Intellect (Ex)

At 13th level the Tactician may now enter a third state of focus with their Battle Focus known as Void’s Intellect or may activate both Barricaded Mind and Focused Body simultaneously as if they were a single state of focus.

Void’s Intellect: Upon entering the state, the tactician focuses his mind to such a state he almost withdraws from his body. The tactician gains an additional move action and swift action on their turn. These can only be used once, after which they cannot be used again until focus ends.

Enhanced Deadly Knowledge (Ex)

At 15th level, the tactician can use Deadly Knowledge to negate the resistance or immunity an enemy may have to an energy type in place of applying a vulnerability, or they may suppress the DR an enemy may have. This DR cannot be DR/-, but can be DR bypassed by non-material effects such as DR/evil or DR/magic. They can only suppress one type of DR at a time; thus if a creature possesses DR 5/magic and DR 15/silver, they only suppress one of these.

Masterful Speech (Ex)

At 16th level, the words spoken by the tactician during his Inspiring Speech are particularly powerful and moving. The ability score bonus granted by this ability increases to +4. Alternatively, this bonus can be split between two scores, granting a +2 insight bonus to one ability score and a +2 bonus to another.

Master Tactical Style (Ex)

At 17th level, the tactician learns the pinnacle of benefits to grant their allies, making their allies powerful against oncoming threats.

Toughened: Coordination now grants DR/- to allies with the DR equal to the bonus granted.

Destruction: Allies benefitting from Coordination deal an additional +4d8 damage on weapon damage rolls. This damage is the same type as their weapon’s damage.

Reflecting: Allies benefitting from Coordination receive Spell Resistance equal to 15 + the tactician’s level.

Luck: Allies benefitting from Coordination act as though they’re under the effects of Fortune for the first roll they make on their turn.

Heroic Inspiration (Ex)

At 20th level, the tactician can push one party member to perform a near impossible feat.

As an immediate action the tactician can choose a target ally within their line of sight, that ally gains haste, the benefit of Coordination, adds x1 to their weapon’s critical multiplier, gains 80 temporary hit points, and gains Freedom of Movement.

This all lasts for 1 hour per point of the tactician’s Intelligence, and the target is exhausted for half the duration afterwards (minimum of 30 minutes). This can only be used once per day.
